tips.title: Thinning Vallejo Model Air for Airbrushing
tips.text: Vallejo Model Air is already thin, but for optimal airbrush performance, mix 1 part paint with 1 part Vallejo Airbrush Thinner (71.261). Add 1-2 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver (71.262) per 10 drops of thinner to enhance flow. Test on a white plastic spoon; if the paint runs smoothly without pooling, it's ready. Use a 0.2mm nozzle at 1.0-1.5 bar pressure for even coverage. Avoid over-thinning to prevent color loss in multiple passes.

tips.title: Base Coat Techniques with Tamiya XF-301
tips.text: Apply Tamiya XF-301 (black) as a base coat for dark colors. Spray 2-3 light coats, allowing 10 minutes between layers. For metallic surfaces, use a 0.3mm nozzle at 1.2 bar pressure. Use a Tamiya 0.2mm nozzle for finer details. Ensure the base coat is fully dry before applying washes or weathering effects to prevent muddying.

tips.title: Camouflage Masking with Scale75 Masking Tape
tips.text: Use Scale75 blue masking tape to mask camouflage patterns. Apply tape to the model surface, ensuring it's flat and free of bubbles. Peel off the tape after the paint has dried to reveal sharp edges. For complex patterns, use a Tamiya 0.1mm brush to apply paint in sections. Remove tape immediately after drying to avoid smudging. Use a 0.3mm nozzle for precise line application.

tips.title: Applying Washes with AK Interactive Pigment Wash
tips.text: Mix AK Interactive Pigment Wash (7051) with 1 part water for a thin wash. Apply with a Tamiya 0.3mm brush, dabbing onto recessed areas. Let dry for 30 minutes, then spray with Tamiya Clear Activator (71.141) to enhance adhesion. For better results, mix with 1 part Mr. Hobby 4060 Water Base Thinner. Use a sponge for large areas, but avoid over-saturating the surface.

tips.title: Gloss Coat Before Decals with Tamiya Clear Lacquer
tips.text: Apply Tamiya Clear Lacquer (71.141) as a gloss coat before decals. Spray 2-3 light coats, allowing 15 minutes between each. Use a Tamiya 0.2mm nozzle at 1.0 bar pressure. Ensure the surface is completely dry before applying decals to prevent lifting. Use a decal setting solution like Scale75 Decal Set (75.014) for best adhesion. Avoid over-spraying to prevent decal distortion.
